<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F2EB"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="none" stroke="none"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F2EB"/>
  <g opacity="0.14">
    <circle cx="332" cy="120" r="84" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="690" r="110" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="360" cy="710" r="70" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <g transform="translate(299,15)">
      <rect x="0" y="5" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
      <rect x="5" y="3" width="3" height="10" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
      <rect x="10" y="1" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
      <rect x="15" y="0" width="3" height="13" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
      <circle cx="42" cy="6" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <line x1="39" y1="6" x2="45" y2="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <line x1="42" y1="3" x2="42" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <rect x="53" y="2" width="24" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <rect x="77" y="6" width="2.5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
      <rect x="55" y="4" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Conversation header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="54" width="390" height="70" fill="#F5F2EB"/>
    <g transform="translate(16,72)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="18" fill="#C7B7A3"/>
      <text x="18" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">D</text>
      <circle cx="46" cy="18" r="18" fill="#7D96A8"/>
      <text x="46" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">E</text>
      <circle cx="74" cy="18" r="18" fill="#8E6C88"/>
      <text x="74" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">T</text>
      <text x="104" y="16" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="18.33px" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Time travelers</text>
      <text x="104" y="36" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="12" fill="#767779">Dr. Who, Emmett “Doc” Brown, Titor</text>
      <g transform="translate(310,-4)">
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="12" fill="#0A0A0A08"/>
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
        <line x1="16" y1="16" x2="21" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(336,-4)">
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="12" fill="#0A0A0A08"/>
        <rect x="7" y="7" width="10" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
        <line x1="10" y1="12" x2="14" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Date chip -->
  <g transform="translate(145,132)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="100" height="28" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="50" y="18.5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#767779">Today · 7:24 PM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Chat bubbles -->
  <g>
    <!-- Dr. Who -->
    <g transform="translate(16,172)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="18" fill="#6F8AA4"/>
      <text x="18" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">W</text>
      <text x="44" y="10" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Dr. Who</text>
      <text x="44" y="26" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" fill="#767779">7:24 PM</text>
      <g>
        <rect x="44" y="34" width="228" height="66" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E2D8"/>
        <polygon points="44,54 36,62 44,70" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E2D8"/>
        <text x="58" y="54" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">We’ve got a new lead on the</text>
        <text x="58" y="74" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">pandorica. Meet me by the</text>
        <text x="58" y="94" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">blue police box in 5.</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Emmett -->
    <g transform="translate(16,266)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="18" fill="#C66C3E"/>
      <text x="18" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">D</text>
      <text x="44" y="10" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Emmett “Doc” Brown</text>
      <text x="44" y="26" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" fill="#767779">7:26 PM</text>
      <g>
        <rect x="44" y="34" width="250" height="86" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E2D8"/>
        <polygon points="44,56 36,64 44,72" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E2D8"/>
        <text x="58" y="54" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">Great Scott! I can rig the flux</text>
        <text x="58" y="74" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">capacitor, but we need 1.21</text>
        <text x="58" y="94" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">gigawatts and a clean runway.</text>
        <text x="58" y="114" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">Bring the Delorean keys.</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Titor -->
    <g transform="translate(16,380)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="18" fill="#8E6C88"/>
      <text x="18" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">T</text>
      <text x="44" y="10" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Titor</text>
      <text x="44" y="26" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" fill="#767779">7:29 PM</text>
      <g>
        <rect x="44" y="34" width="220" height="62" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E2D8"/>
        <polygon points="44,52 36,60 44,68" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E2D8"/>
        <text x="58" y="54" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">Timeline is unstable, but the</text>
        <text x="58" y="74" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">checkpoint still holds.</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Dr. Who reply -->
    <g transform="translate(16,468)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="18" fill="#6F8AA4"/>
      <text x="18" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">W</text>
      <text x="44" y="10" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Dr. Who</text>
      <text x="44" y="26" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" fill="#767779">7:31 PM</text>
      <g>
        <rect x="44" y="34" width="260" height="84" rx="18" fill="#E1F5E8" stroke="#CBE8D6"/>
        <polygon points="44,56 36,64 44,72" fill="#E1F5E8" stroke="#CBE8D6"/>
        <text x="58" y="54" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">Copy that. If the paradox is</text>
        <text x="58" y="74" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">closed, we can still slip through</text>
        <text x="58" y="94" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">on a looped transmission.</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Emmett -->
    <g transform="translate(16,574)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="18" fill="#C66C3E"/>
      <text x="18" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">D</text>
      <text x="44" y="10" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Emmett “Doc” Brown</text>
      <text x="44" y="26" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" fill="#767779">7:34 PM</text>
      <g>
        <rect x="44" y="34" width="266" height="106" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E2D8"/>
        <polygon points="44,58 36,66 44,74" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E2D8"/>
        <text x="58" y="54" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">I’ve got a better idea—use</text>
        <text x="58" y="74" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">the train. Same physics, more</text>
        <text x="58" y="94" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">dramatic lighting. Also,</text>
        <text x="58" y="114" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">don’t forget the bearings.</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Titor typing -->
    <g transform="translate(16,700)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="18" fill="#8E6C88"/>
      <text x="18" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">T</text>
      <text x="44" y="10" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Titor</text>
      <text x="44" y="26" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="11" fill="#767779">7:36 PM</text>
      <g>
        <rect x="44" y="34" width="168" height="54" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E2D8"/>
        <polygon points="44,50 36,58 44,66" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E2D8"/>
        <text x="58" y="56" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">I’ll send the coordinates.</text>
        <text x="58" y="76" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15.8px" fill="#000000">Stay off the main line.</text>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Input bar -->
  <g transform="translate(0,768)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="76" fill="#F5F2EB"/>
    <rect x="12" y="10" width="330" height="46" rx="23" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E1DDD5"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="33" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="39" x2="46" y2="45" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="54" y="38" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" fill="#767779">Message</text>
    <g transform="translate(352,10)">
      <circle cx="19" cy="23" r="23" fill="#1DAB61"/>
      <polygon points="14,23 25,18 21,29" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <line x1="17" y1="23" x2="24" y2="23" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#F4F4F4CC" stroke="#00000033"/>
    <g transform="translate(20,780)">
      <g>
        <rect x="5" y="5" width="22" height="20" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <polyline points="6,14 16,8 26,14" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <rect x="13" y="14" width="6" height="11" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <text x="16" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">Chats</text>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(104,780)">
      <g>
        <circle cx="16" cy="15" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <line x1="16" y1="9" x2="16" y2="21" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <line x1="10" y1="15" x2="22" y2="15" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <text x="16" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">Status</text>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(184,780)">
      <g>
        <rect x="6" y="6" width="20" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <polygon points="26,10 31,7 31,21 26,18" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <text x="16" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">Calls</text>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(265,780)">
      <g>
        <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="11" fill="#1DAB61"/>
        <line x1="16" y1="10" x2="16" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
        <line x1="10" y1="16" x2="22" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
        <text x="16" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#1DAB61">New</text>
      </g>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(339,780)">
      <g>
        <circle cx="16" cy="15" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <circle cx="16" cy="10" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <rect x="11" y="16" width="10" height="6" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <text x="16" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">Me</text>
      </g>
    </g>
    <rect x="125" y="811" width="140" height="5" rx="100" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
  </g>

  <!-- subtle dividers and bubbles count for detail -->
  <g opacity="0.22">
    <line x1="16" y1="238" x2="374" y2="238" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="332" x2="374" y2="332" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="446" x2="374" y2="446" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="540" x2="374" y2="540" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="666" x2="374" y2="666" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- decorative stars as rating-like icons -->
  <g transform="translate(298,142)" opacity="0.7">
    <polygon points="8,0 10,5 15,5 11,8 12,13 8,10 4,13 5,8 1,5 6,5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <polygon points="26,0 28,5 33,5 29,8 30,13 26,10 22,13 23,8 19,5 24,5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
  </g>
</svg>
